claims.text: The Air Force's own base history lists the installation commanders in sequence: 'Colonel Glen McClernon August 1962 / Colonel Arthur E. Exon August 1964 / Colonel Jowell C. Wise December 1965'. Exon held the post as a colonel, from August 1964, and was succeeded in December 1965.

label: Arthur E. Exon
narrative: Arthur E. Exon was installation commander of Wright-Patterson Air Force Base from August 1964 to December 1965. The Air Force's own centennial history of the base lists him in its table of installation commanders as a colonel, between Colonel Glen McClernon and Colonel Jowell C. Wise. He reaches this board only through the Danny Jones corpus, where Whitley Strieber calls him General Exon and attributes to him an account of 1947 material at this installation. Nothing in the opened record touches that account, and the record corrects the rank the corpus gives him for the period he actually held the command.
